episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens with gaming chat before Peter Gibbon appears as a dog streamer hyping the Elsie fighting game. Rick Triple delivers a cynical breakdown of nationwide campus protests over Gaza, framing police crackdowns as corporate compliance training. Trent at the Movies reviews trailers including Mayor of Kingstown, a Japanese reality-show documentary, a Jim Henson tribute, a 1981 Chevy Chase comedy, and Zoe Kravitz's Blink Twice. Case tests an AI study claiming to predict politics from neutral faces (r=0.22), outperforming both chat and ChatGPT. Hype Train interrupts with gold eyes and a neutrality rap. The Jo Rogen Experience spirals into smart-appliance parenting, nuclear-reactor workouts, butthole tanning via belt mirror, human hunting with Bob Costas, and a horror-tunnel studio entrance. Munch & Crum close by debating whether the lemon-drop mascot is a baby, confirming Foghorn Leghorn's chicken-KKK membership, and clashing over Yeezy porn versus traditional porn. Pepito raids Spinachy to end the broadcast.
